assessment.reason: The projection is mostly prior-driven: only one 2026 game, with zero targets, appears in the sample. A plus-money under has a plausible mechanism, but Sampson's current role and status are unknown, and his absence from the sample is unexplained.
assessment.model_case: With one current game, recent form carries little weight, so the 1.15 mean comes largely from prior history and default efficiency. Opponent and venue adjustments are negligible. Calibration trims a moderate raw under view, and the case hinges on whether the prior matches his current role.
assessment.price_case: All books post 1.5. BetOnline's +125 is the best under price, against even money to +120 elsewhere, and break-even is roughly four in nine. Books favoring the over suggests they expect a real receiving role, a disagreement the thin sample cannot settle.
assessment.context_case: No Browns or Titans reporting was supplied, so why Sampson is missing from Weeks 2-6 is unverified. This bet shares game exposure with the Spears over.
blocking_checks: Why Sampson has only one 2026 game in the sample (injury, inactive or depth) and his expected role Sunday. A lead or passing-down role would undercut the prior-driven under.

qualitative_review.countercase: Books shading the over implies an expected role larger than the sample shows. Sampson caught five passes against Tennessee in 2025, though that history is not predictive. If he is a primary passing-down back, two catches is easily reachable.

assessment.model_case: Spears caught 2, 2, 0, 1, 9 and 1 passes. The 2.64 mean sits barely above 2.5 and is driven by Week 5. The very high catch-rate assumption is also inflated by that outlier. A mean near the line from a skewed distribution overstates the chance of three or more, and calibration nudging upward adds no real support.
assessment.price_case: All five books post 2.5. DraftKings' +125 is the best over price, against +102 to +115 elsewhere, and break-even is roughly four in nine. De-vigged consensus sits near break-even, so value depends entirely on a fragile model mean.
assessment.context_case: No Titans or Browns reporting was supplied, so participation, backfield split and game script are unverified. This bet shares an exposure group with the Sampson under and is not independent of it.

qualitative_review.countercase: If Week 5's nine targets reflected a recurring game-plan role, such as trailing scripts or a teammate absence, three catches is live and +125 would be generous. Spears caught four and two passes in prior Browns meetings, but opponent history is not predictive.
